```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)
df <- read_csv("ds_salaries.csv") |> mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

# Shown instead of a plot when the inputs leave no rows
empty_plot <- function() {
  plotly_empty() |>
    layout(title = list(text = "No flights match these inputs.", y = 0.5))
}
```

```{r}
head(df)
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

Data science salaries have grown significantly in recent years, with wide variation based on experience, location, and role. Use the inputs below to explore salary trends and filter the plots and table on the **Data** page.

```{r}
# Inputs


dateRangeInput("dates", "Date Range",
               start = min(small_df$fl_date), end = max(small_df$fl_date),
               min = min(small_df$fl_date), max = max(small_df$fl_date))
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Diversions by Carrier
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: Arrival Delay by Carrier
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Data used in the plots (filtered by the inputs on the Plots page)
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
filtered <- reactive({
  small_df |>
    filter(fl_date >= input$dates[1], fl_date <= input$dates[2])
})

output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  p <- ggplot(
    filtered() |> filter(diverted == 1),
    aes(x = op_unique_carrier)) +
    geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
    labs(
      x = "Carrier",
      y = "Number of Diversions",
      title = "Flight Diversions by Carrier")
  ggplotly(p)
})

output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  p <- ggplot(
    filtered() |> filter(!is.na(arr_delay)),
    aes(x = op_unique_carrier, y = arr_delay)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
    labs(x = "Airline",
         y = "Arrival Delay (minutes)",
         title = "Arrival Delay by Carrier") 
  ggplotly(p)
})

output$tbl <- renderDT({
  filtered() |>
  datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10))
})
```
